build_pipeline_digits_classification: build a sklearn Pipeline chaining StandardScaler, PCA, and LogisticRegression for digits classification
run_gridsearchcv_pipeline: run GridSearchCV on a Pipeline to find best PCA components and LogisticRegression C parameter
